newsitem.title: USA: US spot liquids little changed in thin late trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot liquids little changed in thin late trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquids prices were little changed late Wednesday, traders said, with few deals spotted as many players attended the two-day annual Purvin & Gertz conference in Houston, Texas.
"I didn't hear of one deal done this morning here," one Conway trader said, adding about five transactions then popped up about lunchtime to give a little zest to the sleepy market.
Mont Belvieu propane was offered at 38.50 cents a gallon, traders said, stable with midday, while Conway material also held steady at 36.75 cents, traders said.
